_readme: Every message the contact form can show, in one place. Read at runtime by
public/contact.php and imported at build time by pages/Contact/Contact.tsx,
so a string lives here once rather than once per runtime.
WIDTH BUDGET: these render on one line beside the Send link, in a sprite
font that does not wrap. Anything much past ~26 characters runs under Send
and out of the panel. tests/message-widths.mjs measures every string below
against the real glyph widths in src/font.css and fails if one will not fit,
so you do not have to count characters by eye.
Keys are referenced by name in both runtimes. Renaming one means changing it
in both; changing the text means changing nothing else.
Lines starting with an underscore are ignored by everything that reads this.
busy: Form is busy. Try again later.
